Subject: Q2 holdlist: quick stage scrub request

Morning —

Reminder: finance will lock commit at 5pm PT tomorrow and we still have a handful of deals with stale stages or missing close dates. I pulled a quick snapshot (attached) and flagged the obvious risks. For SFDC-9876 (Swyft Logistics) I have a yellow flag — missing finalized M&A review signoff + procurement told us they need a clarified billing cadence.

As the owner, can you do a focused scrub on the following before EOD tomorrow:
- Confirm stage and firm close date (if not firm, mark as OMM and give probability justification)
- Upload latest MAP and procurement notes to the Drive link (listed below)
- Call out any blockers that require manager intervention (loop Laura)

I attached the Q2_holdlist_snapshot.csv with my comments. If you need me to take the procurement outreach, say so and I'll ping Caitlin.

Thanks,
Ben

Ben —

Got it. I'm on SFDC-9876 and two others from the yellow list. Quick notes:

From: Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.com>
To: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 04 May 2027 16:30:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Q2 holdlist: quick stage scrub request — priority playbook + manager actions

Thanks for the updates. I've reviewed Ben's snapshot and Marissa's plan — good start. Two quick manager-level asks to accelerate stabilization: 

1) Triage severity and owner accountability
- Move any deal missing a signed MAP or procurement timeline to the redwatch list immediately. Mark owner and required action (e.g., "procurement commit", "legal redline", "finance signoff").

2) Manager interventions (my role)
- I'll take ownership of escalations where the external procurement team is not responsive within 24 hours after Marissa's outreach.
- If procurement needs an alternative billing option to secure signature, approve offering a one-time trial billing cadence (internal approval required) — Marissa, flag for me and give projected ARR impact.

3) Rapid-response checklist (see attached PDF) — use when moving a deal from yellow->red:
- Confirm primary external approver and phone number
- Date-stamp last procurement contact and next scheduled follow-up
- Attach MAP and last procurement email in HubSpot
- Estimate probability with reason notes (no generic % without a rationale)

Marissa, after your call with Caitlin, please do two things: update the HubSpot record and post the MAP to Drive. Ben, if you can open a short thread with procurement@... and cc me, I'll step in if there's no reply by tomorrow noon PT.

Attachment: commit_rapid_response_checklist.pdf (PDF, 28KB)

Laura Bennett
VP, Sales Operations | Redwood Inference
laura_bennett@redwood.com

From: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>

Subject: Re: Q2 holdlist: quick stage scrub request — Swyft update

Quick status update following this morning's outreach:
- Spoke with Caitlin (procurement lead) — she confirmed they need a clarified monthly billing cadence in the MAP. She expects to route to legal by Friday if we provide the requested language.
- I uploaded Swyft_MutualActionPlan.docx (v2) to the Drive and attached the DocuSign intent link in HubSpot.
- Per Laura's checklist, I dated the procurement email and attached it to the HubSpot timeline. Updated probability to 55% with rationale (procurement has requested concrete billing language; contingent on legal review).

Next steps:
- Marissa: please track legal routing and confirm by EOD Friday whether they proceed to signature. If no confirmation, we move to redwatch on Monday morning.
- Laura: please approve the one-time billing cadence trial if legal pushes back and they request it to move forward; I noted estimated ARR impact in the MAP.

I also attached the cleaned snapshot (CSV) with the final statuses.

Thanks — will flag immediately if anything changes.
Ben
